reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, nxt.valid_from AS changed_on, old.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, nxt.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
FROM price_history old
JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = old.product_id AND nxt.valid_from = old.valid_to + 1
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = old.product_id
WHERE nxt.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND nxt.list_price_eur < 0.9 * old.list_price_eur
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, nxt.valid_from AS changed_on, old.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, nxt.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur FROM products p JOIN price_history old ON old.product_id = p.product_id JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = old.product_id AND old.valid_to = nxt.valid_from - 1 WHERE year(nxt.valid_from) = 2025 AND nxt.list_price_eur / old.list_price_eur < 0.9

WITH next_start AS (SELECT a.product_id, a.valid_from, MIN(b.valid_from) AS next_from FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from GROUP BY a.product_id, a.valid_from) SELECT p.product_name, n.next_from AS changed_on, old.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, nxt.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur FROM next_start n JOIN price_history old ON old.product_id = n.product_id AND old.valid_from = n.valid_from JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = n.product_id AND nxt.valid_from = n.next_from JOIN products p ON p.product_id = n.product_id WHERE n.next_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND nxt.list_price_eur < 0.9 * old.list_price_eur

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_name, n.valid_from AS changed_on, o.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur, n.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
FROM price_history n
JOIN price_history o ON o.product_id = n.product_id AND o.valid_to + 1 = n.valid_from
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = n.product_id
WHERE n.valid_from >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND n.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND n.list_price_eur < 0.9 * o.list_price_eur
